text: Therapeutic empathy improves patient and practitioner outcomes, yet existing measures are often lengthy, conceptually inconsistent, and difficult to compare across respondent groups. Brief, universal measures (usable by patients, practitioners, students, and observers) are lacking. We developed a universal single-item scale – the Rapid Assessment of Therapeutic Empathy (RATE) scale – and conducted psychometric testing of the patient-reported version.
source_label: Rapid Assessment of Therapeutic Empathy (RATE): Development of a universal single-item empathy scale and validation of the patient-reported version
